title: Escaped pipe discards the value
intent: Create a two-column table whose key is A|B and whose value is 100.
bug: A backslash-escaped pipe is split as a column boundary. The resulting table loses 100.
novelty: Known comparison case; now also live-confirmed.
status: Live Google Docs failure; gdoc reports success
commands:
gdoc cat DOC --tab TAB --account PERSONAL
gdoc write DOC specimen.md --tab TAB --account PERSONAL

title: Empty cell shifts the value
intent: Create a table with an empty Key cell and 100 under Value.
bug: A compact empty first cell is stripped before splitting the row. 100 moves into Key, leaving Value blank. Adding a space inside the empty cell avoids this particular trigger.
novelty: Additional trigger within the broad Markdown grammar area.
status: Live Google Docs failure; gdoc reports success
commands:
gdoc cat DOC --tab TAB --account PERSONAL
gdoc write DOC specimen.md --tab TAB --account PERSONAL

title: Code fence ends too early
intent: Write the whole fenced specimen as literal code.
bug: A fence-like line with trailing text is mistaken for the closing fence. That line disappears and the following literal asterisks become bold formatting.
status: Live Google Docs failure; gdoc reports success
commands:
gdoc cat DOC --tab TAB --account PERSONAL
gdoc write DOC specimen.md --tab TAB --account PERSONAL

title: Link title enters the destination
intent: Create a Policy hyperlink to https://example.com/policy.
bug: The optional Markdown title is included in the actual hyperlink URL. The visible label looks correct, so a text-only check misses the failure.
novelty: Additional trigger within the existing link grammar area.
status: Live Google Docs failure; gdoc reports success
commands:
gdoc cat DOC --tab TAB --account PERSONAL
gdoc write DOC specimen.md --tab TAB --account PERSONAL

title: Double-backtick code is corrupted
intent: Write a code span containing one literal backtick.
bug: The parser treats a multi-backtick delimiter as single-backtick fragments. It changes the literal code and leaves delimiter characters in the visible sentence.
status: Live Google Docs failure; gdoc reports success
commands:
gdoc cat DOC --tab TAB --account PERSONAL
gdoc write DOC specimen.md --tab TAB --account PERSONAL

title: Trailing backslash breaks code
intent: Write the literal code C:\temp\, including its final backslash.
bug: Backslash escaping is applied before code-span recognition. The closing delimiter is treated as escaped: code formatting disappears and the path changes.
status: Live Google Docs failure; gdoc reports success
commands:
gdoc cat DOC --tab TAB --account PERSONAL
gdoc write DOC specimen.md --tab TAB --account PERSONAL

title: Literal code breaks surrounding bold
intent: Make the whole sentence bold while preserving a**b as literal code.
bug: Asterisks inside the code span terminate the surrounding emphasis. The code text is altered and formatting markers leak into the output.
novelty: Additional code-span precedence trigger; same broad repair area as H05–H06.
status: Live Google Docs failure; gdoc reports success
commands:
gdoc cat DOC --tab TAB --account PERSONAL
gdoc write DOC specimen.md --tab TAB --account PERSONAL
